messages.subject: business-panel succeeded
messages.body: worker_status: succeeded; the brief guard passed and /sc:business-panel ran unattended with Porter and Drucker in discussion mode on D1 option-a.md. Both experts back option (a); the panel found that ~/.claude/WORKER-CONTRACT.md:16-19 (brief guard) already refuses a missing flag before work, so option-a.md's 'known weakness' line 19 is out of date, and 'changing later is cheap' (line 23) is only safe if detection warns and never switches. Nothing is left in the worker; the report's SPEC/CAPS citations were not verified, and nothing was staged, committed or pushed (only .dev/p1-live/ is untracked).
